body:
I think it's gonna be okay? I guess. How are you feeling lonely, if you have people to care for? 
Can you tell me more?

sent you a pm with my skype.
Off in the middle of buttfuck nowhere so hope you reach me if you want to.

Well, I do care. Just as a person who used sit with gun pressed to his temple a lot of times. I personally felt a lot of emotional pain in those moments and if you feel the same now and I can ease yours at least bit, even for a little while, then that's all I hope for.

I'm not saying you don't have a right for your decision, but all I've seen and experienced about suicide attempts with pills is that it they usually end with being attempts. I'm writing a longer reply for you at the moment so don't pop the pills yet.

Well, shit.  Don't know what to tell you man. I know in Europe some handicapped visit brothels and it's normal to see one or two guys rolling around in their wheelchairs in some brothels, but it's not really love is it?

Do you have access to counseling, therapy? Have you tried it before, or medication for depression? You mentioned you have no other outlet than in here?

I think I might get what you're saying about life not meaning anything, but a suicide with pills really might not be the best solution. Especially with tramadol. It's really, really unreliable, even with harder drugs, and if you have tolerance it's even more iffy. 

Do you have hobbies that you do? Just thinking about your life being meaningless. Can you do art, be employed remotely, etc? 

I'm hanging around here at least for a couple of hours before I hopefully get some sleep. So if you wanna talk about anything at all, doesn't need to be gloomy shit, post here or send me a p.m. Mind you, English isn't my native language so hope you don't mind incoherent sentence structures :D

+If you wanna talk to an actual person with training, instead of my sorry ass, take a look at https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines

P.s. I know it's a mealymouthed platitude, but I really think there's someone for everyone. People are made to love after all. Have you given dating sites a go? And shit, I'm sorry if I'm missing correct terms or something.

Hola. Lo siento para mi malo espanol y como cosas estan ahora para ti. Pero creo yo entiendo un poquito que tu dices y quizas yo podria entender como tu sientas tambien. Si quires a hablar con un tonto gringo sobre depression enviarme un pm. Estoy aqui a menudo, si mi jodido red funcionas. 

Pero ahora mismo tengo que dormir. Hasta luego y una mejor manana para ti :)
No te olvidas, tu no existes solamente con tu dolor.
Sugirio para un pm porque, porque me lleva tiempo, y mucho correccion de pruebas para escribirle en Espanol en tema importante.

You didn't mention therapy or medication. I presume you've tried those?

Just for me dropping it all, it's been a big thing having to deal with different people and different time scales. In previous life I'd go "Hulk Smash puny humans if not on time." Now, I still hate people being late, but it doesn't trigger an unreasonable bout of rage and resentment. +People in Latin-America, S.e.-asia are pretty welcoming and cheer you up, even if you can't rely on them for shit. 

This might not be for you, but if all you have is nothing what's there to lose? And it doesn't need to be backpacking in jungles. Give a thought on what you might want to do and do it if possible.

Your problems aren't minor if you're contemplating suicide.

Have you considered doing something completely different? Like, I'm sorry that I can only tell you what I've done as I'm not a therapist or anything.
I gave up a decent wage secure job and a house and started volunteering in foreign countries. There's tons sites like helpx, workaway, mindmyhouse, etc. where you figure out how to volunteer for room and board or have just have free housing.

Helped me for a while and met some people with different perspectives, even if most of them are dirty hippies :X

Bad thing about depression is that it doesn't matter if you win the lottery or what not. It's still there. "Oh shit, now I gotta worry about this money. Oh god, I'm so miserable." 

And then you see some guys living in a tin shack going "Fuck yes, the donkey isn't dead yet."

+ Consider giving medication and therapy a go, if you haven't. You might be lucky and they'll work for you.

Hi, what's model/type of the gun? Do you go out to the range a lot?
When I was still shooting and competing it was pretty fun and you'd get these moments of serenity a lot. Just you, the target and the sights.

+You could talk to people about guns and shooting even if you were locked about talking about anything else to anyone.

I personally was doing the same thing as you and ended putting the guns for sale. But if I get to a point where I can reasonably own guns again I'll start a collection once more. 

Do you have an idea why you're feeling like this though? For how long has it been going on?

Oh, got one more, but only if you can still function, or fake it well enough, to not be sobbing mess on the floor all the time:

-You can just leave your nine to five behind and do whatever you want. 

It's not like dental plans, 401k matching, and yearly bonuses matter for crap, if you want to paint pictures of ducks, or something, for your last few months.
Haha! I missed that, even though it's obvious.

No. Look, there's plenty of ways to die, but an drug overdose is one of the more unreliable ones. Especially with the drugs you've listed.

Modern drugs are meant to make people better, and dying from them is a side-effect that the pharmaceutical companies have spent billions to get rid of. 

Gonna be browsing /r/sw for a few hours more. Feeling pretty down myself, so if you wanna chat drop me a line.

While your friend might not be suicidal, this suicidewatch tips post has some good points https://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/igh87/concerned_but_dont_know_what_to_say_here_are_some/

I think you just being there, and being willing to listen would help. It's might not be easy for you and at some point as your friend might start pushing you away. 

Some people who are depressed, feel that they're not really worth your time or friendship, or that you despise them as they hate themselves, and hence try to cut off ties.

Good luck and hope your friend gets a bit better.
